newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds follow Chicago lead.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds follow Chicago lead.

text.p: Prices on the UK meals and feeds market tumbled on Tuesday morning following the sharply lower closein Chicago the previous night.
Chicago soybeans hit limit down following the USDA's acreage report which pegged soybean plantings at 70.85 million acres, the highest for 15 years.
High protein soymeal was as much as six stg down ex-mill while stores were two to three stg lower.
Brokers said there was interest in nearby soymeal, but nothing for new crop.
"Bids have been coming in around two stg under the asking prices for spot material at 182 stg but nothing substantial has been reported traded, said one broker.
In the rest of the market new crop rapemeal ex-mill was two stg down while sunflower pellets were three stg lower.
